title: Work IQ: how agents reach Microsoft 365 and business data, and what an admin can switch off
summary: Microsoft has deferred the November rollout to existing environments, so administrators must not rely on the page's automatic-enablement schedule. The page also reports App Access automation as undocumented even though Dataverse documents an update operation and its allow/block property. The cited pages were accessible during this check; the earlier HTTP 429 responses did not establish broken links.

claims.claim: Work IQ is Microsoft's workplace intelligence layer for agents and applications to reason over organizational data.
claims.quote: Work IQ is a workplace intelligence layer that enables agents to access and reason over organizational and business data, context, and tools.

claims.claim: Business Applications in Work IQ adds Dynamics 365 and Power Apps business data, including preview capabilities.
claims.quote: Business Applications in Work IQ is a set of capabilities that lets Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, Copilot Cowork, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients work with Power Apps and Dynamics 365 data.

claims.claim: Requests run in the context of a signed-in user and access only what that user is allowed to see or do.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: Work IQ is accessible through agent-to-agent communication (A2A).
claims.quote: A2A | Structured agent-to-agent communication

claims.claim: Work IQ exposes a remote Model Context Protocol server for tool-based access.
claims.quote: Remote MCP | Tool-based context access | IDEs, CLIs, AI coding assistants

claims.claim: Work IQ is accessible through a REST API.
claims.quote: Work IQ API endpoints include A2A, a remote MCP server, and a REST API.

claims.claim: Chat provides conversational answers through A2A and REST.
claims.quote: Work IQ supports A2A for agent-to-agent collaboration and REST for web application interactions, enabling agents to delegate work, maintain continuity, and deliver fully processed, Copilot-quality responses.

claims.claim: Context assembles grounded inputs without agents managing retrieval pipelines.
claims.quote: Work IQ assembles and grounds context internally across organizational and business data to provide agent-ready inputs, so agents don't need to stitch together raw signals or manage retrieval pipelines.

claims.claim: Generic tools use verbs such as fetch, create, and update on resource paths.
claims.quote: These tools function as simple verbs (such as fetch, create, and update), while resource paths define what the agent is working with.

claims.claim: Workspaces use SharePoint Embedded working storage for intermediate data and outputs.
claims.quote: SharePoint Embedded working storage gives agents a persistent space within your Microsoft 365 tenant boundary to manage intermediate data and outputs
